sections.label: A prayer to Indra, identified with Vishnu and the Sun
sections.name: Hymn 1

verses.sa:
विषासहिं सहमानं सासहानं सहीयांसम्।
सहमानं सहोजितं स्वर्जितं गोजितं संधनाजितम्।
ईड्यं नाम ह्व इन्द्रमायुष्मान् भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsam sahamānaṃ sahojitaṃ svarjitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃdhanājitam īḍyaṃ nāma hva indramāyuṣmān bhūyāsam
verses.en: Vanquishing, overpowering, a conqueror, exceeding strong, Victorious, winner of the light, winner of cattle and of spoil, Indra by name, adorable, I call: along, long life be mine!

verses.sa:
विषासहिं सहमानं सासहानं सहीयांसम्।
सहमानं सहोजितं स्वर्जितं गोजितं संधनाजितम्।
ईड्यं नाम ह्व इन्द्रं प्रियो देवानां भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsam sahamānaṃ sahojitaṃ svarjitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃdhanājitam īḍyaṃ nāma hva indraṃ priyo devānāṃ bhūyāsam
verses.en: Vanquishing, etc. Indra by name, adorable I call: may I be dear to Gods,

verses.sa:
विषासहिं सहमानं सासहानं सहीयांसम्।
सहमानं सहोजितं स्वर्जितं गोजितं संधनाजितम्।
ईड्यं नाम ह्व इन्द्रं प्रियः प्रजानां भयासम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsam sahamānaṃ sahojitaṃ svarjitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃdhanājitam īḍyaṃ nāma hva indraṃ priyaḥ prajānāṃ bhayāsam
verses.en: Vanquishing, etc. Indra by name, adorable, I call: may creatures love me well.

verses.sa:
विषासहिं सहमानं सासहानं सहीयांसम्।
सहमानं सहोजितं स्वर्जितं गोजितं संधनाजितम्।
ईड्यं नाम ह्व इन्द्रं प्रियः पशूनां भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsam sahamānaṃ sahojitaṃ svarjitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃdhanājitam īḍyaṃ nāma hva indraṃ priyaḥ paśūnāṃ bhūyāsam
verses.en: Vanquishing, etc. Indra by name, adorable, I call; may cattle hold me l dear,

verses.sa:
विषासहिं सहमानं सासहानं सहीयांसम्।
सहमानं सहोजितं स्वर्जितं गोजितं संधनाजितम्।
ईड्यं नाम ह्व इन्द्रं प्रियः समानानां भूयासम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ sāsahānaṃ sahīyāṃsam sahamānaṃ sahojitaṃ svarjitaṃ gojitaṃ saṃdhanājitam īḍyaṃ nāma hva indraṃ priyaḥ samānānāṃ bhūyāsam
verses.en: Vanquishing, etc. Indra by name, adorable, I call: may equals love me well,

verses.sa:
उदिह्युदिहि सूर्य वर्चसा माभ्युदिहि ।
द्विषंश्च मह्यं रध्यतु मा चाहं द्विषते रधं तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽनि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: udihyudihi sūrya varcasā mābhyudihi dviṣaṃśca mahyaṃ radhyatu mā cāhaṃ dviṣate radhaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ni tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Rise up, O Surya, rise thou up; with strength and splendour rise on me, l Let him who hates me be my thrall; let me not be. a thrall to him, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu. Sate us with cattle of all forms and colours: set me in happiness, in loftiest heaven,

verses.sa:
उदिह्युदिहि सूर्य वर्चसा माभ्युदिहि ।
यांश्च पश्यामि यांश्च न तेषु मा सुमतिं कृधि तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽनि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: udihyudihi sūrya varcasā mābhyudihi yāṃśca paśyāmi yāṃśca na teṣu mā sumatiṃ kṛdhi taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ni tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Rise up, O Surya, rise thou up; with strength and splendour rise on me. Make me the favourite of all, of those I see and do not see, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा दभन्त्सलिले अप्स्व१न्तर्ये पाशिन उपतिष्ठन्त्यत्र ।
हित्वाशस्तिं दिवमारुक्ष एतां स नो मृड सुमतौ ते स्याम तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽनि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: mā tvā dabhantsalile apsva1ntarye pāśina upatiṣṭhantyatra hitvāśastiṃ divamārukṣa etāṃ sa no mṛḍa sumatau te syāma taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ni tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Let not the fowlers who are standing ready injure thee in the flood, within the waters, Ascend this heaven, leaving each curse behind thee. Favour us: let thy gracious love attend us. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र महते सौभगायादब्धेभिः परि पाह्यक्तुभिस्तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽनि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra mahate saubhagāyādabdhebhiḥ pari pāhyaktubhistaved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ni tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Do thou, O Indra, for our great good fortune, with thine inviolable rays protect us, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्रोतिभिः शिवाभिः शंतमो भव ।
आरोहंस्त्रिदिवं दिवो गृणानः सोमपीतये प्रियधामा स्वस्तये तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indrotibhiḥ śivābhiḥ śaṃtamo bhava ārohaṃstridivaṃ divo gṛṇānaḥ somapītaye priyadhāmā svastaye taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Be thou most gracious unto us, Indra, with favourable aid, Rising to heaven's third sphere, invoked with song to quaff the Soma juice, loving thy home to make us blest, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्रासि विश्वजित् सर्ववित् पुरुहूतस्त्वमिन्द्र ।
त्वमिन्द्रेमं सुहवं स्तोममेरयस्व स नो मृड सुमतौ ते स्याम तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvamindrāsi viśvajit sarvavit puruhūtastvamindra tvamindremaṃ suhavaṃ stomamerayasva sa no mṛḍa sumatau te syāma taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Thou art the vanquisher of all, O Indra, omniscient Indra, and invoked of many. Indra, send forth this hymn that fitly lauds thee, Favour us: let thy gracious love attend us. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
अदब्धो दिवि पृथिव्यामुतासि न त आपुर्महिमानमन्तरिक्षे ।
अदब्धेन ब्रह्मणा वावृधानः स त्वं न इन्द्र दिवि संछर्म यच्छ तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: adabdho divi pṛthivyāmutāsi na ta āpurmahimānamantarikṣe adabdhena brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānaḥ sa tvaṃ na indra divi saṃcharma yaccha taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: In heaven and on the earth thou art uninjured, none reach thy greatness in the air's mid region, Increasing by inviolate devotion as such in heaven grant us protection, Indra, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
या त इन्द्र तनूरप्सु या पृथिव्यां यान्तरग्नौ या त इन्द्र पवमाने स्वर्विदि ।
ययेन्द्र तन्वा३ऽन्तरिक्षं व्यापिथ तया न इन्द्र तन्वा३शर्म यच्छ तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: yā ta indra tanūrapsu yā pṛthivyāṃ yāntaragnau yā ta indra pavamāne svarvidi yayendra tanvā3'ntarikṣaṃ vyāpitha tayā na indra tanvā3śarma yaccha taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Grant us protection, Indra, with that body of thine that is on earth, in fire, in waters, That dwells within light-finding Pavamana, wherewith thou hast pervaded air's mid region. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu.

verses.sa:
त्वामिन्द्र ब्रह्मणा वर्धयन्तः सत्रं नि षेदुरऋषयो नाधमानास्तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvāmindra brahmaṇā vardhayantaḥ satraṃ ni ṣeduraṛṣayo nādhamānāstaved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Indra, exalting thee with prayer, imploring, Rishis have sat them down in holy Session. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
त्वं तृतं त्वं पर्येष्युत्सं सहस्रधारं विदथं स्वर्विदं तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tṛtaṃ tvaṃ paryeṣyutsaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vidathaṃ svarvidaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Round Trita, round the spring with thousand currents thou goest, round the light-finding assembly. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu.

verses.sa:
त्वं रक्षसे प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वं शोचिषा नभसी वि भासि ।
त्वमिमा विश्वा भुवनानु तिष्ठस ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेषि विद्वांस्तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ rakṣase pradiśaścatasrastvaṃ śociṣā nabhasī vi bhāsi tvamimā viśvā bhuvanānu tiṣṭhasa ṛtasya panthāmanveṣi vidvāṃstaved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Thou guardest well the four celestial regions, pervading heaven and earth with light and splendour. Thou givest help to all these living creatures, and, knowing, followest the path of Order, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
पञ्चभिः पराङ् तपस्येकयार्वाङशस्तिमेषि सुदिने बाधमानस्तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: pañcabhiḥ parāṅ tapasyekayārvāṅaśastimeṣi sudine bādhamānastaved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: With five thou sendest heat: with one removing the curse thou comest in bright sunshine hither. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu,

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्रस्त्वं महेन्द्रस्त्वं लोकस्त्वं प्रजापतिः ।
तुभ्यं यज्ञो वि तायते तुभ्यं जुह्वति जुह्वतस्तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: tvamindrastvaṃ mahendrastvaṃ lokastvaṃ prajāpatiḥ tubhyaṃ yajño vi tāyate tubhyaṃ juhvati juhvatastaved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: Indra art thou, Mahendra thou, thou art the world; the Lord of Life, To thee is sacrifice performed: worshippers offer gifts to thee. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu, L

verses.sa:
असति सत् प्रतिष्ठितं सति भूतं प्रतिष्ठितम्।
भूतं ह भव्य आहितं भव्यं भूते प्रतिष्ठितं तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: asati sat pratiṣṭhitaṃ sati bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam bhūtaṃ ha bhavya āhitaṃ bhavyaṃ bhūte pratiṣṭhitaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: What is is based on what is not: the present lies on that which is. Present on future is imposed and future on the present based, Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu, Sate us with cattle of all varied colour. Set rae in happiness, in loftiest heaven.

verses.sa:
शुक्रोऽसि भ्राजोऽसि ।
स यथा त्वं भ्राजता भ्राजोऽस्येवाहं भ्राजता भ्राज्यासम्॥
verses.tr: śukro'si bhrājo'si sa yathā tvaṃ bhrājatā bhrājo'syevāhaṃ bhrājatā bhrājyāsam
verses.en: Bright art thou, and refulgent: as thou shinest with splendour so- I fain would shine with splendour,

verses.sa:
रुचिरसि रोचोऽसि ।
स यथा त्वं रुच्या रोचोऽस्येवाहं पशुभिश्च ब्राह्मणवर्चसेन च रुचिषीय॥
verses.tr: rucirasi roco'si sa yathā tvaṃ rucyā roco'syevāhaṃ paśubhiśca brāhmaṇavarcasena ca ruciṣīya
verses.en: Lustre art thou, illuming: as thou glowest with lustre so I too would shine with cattle, with all the lustre of a Brahman's station.

verses.sa:
उद्यते नम उदायते नम उदिताय नमः ।
विराजे नमः स्वराजे नमः सम्राजे नमः॥
verses.tr: udyate nama udāyate nama uditāya namaḥ virāje namaḥ svarāje namaḥ samrāje namaḥ
verses.en: Glory to him when rising, when ascending! Glory to him when he hath reached the zenith! To him far-shining, him the self-refulgent, to him the Sovran Lord and King be glory!

verses.sa:
अस्तंयते नमोऽस्तमेष्यते नमोऽस्तमिताय नमः ।
विराजे नमः स्वराजे नमः सम्राजे नमः॥
verses.tr: astaṃyate namo'stameṣyate namo'stamitāya namaḥ virāje namaḥ svarāje namaḥ samrāje namaḥ
verses.en: Worship to him when he is turning westward, to him when setting, and when set be worship! To him far-shining, him the self-refulgent, to him the Sovran Lord and King be glory!

verses.sa:
उदगादयमादित्यो विश्वेन तपसा सह।
सपत्नान् मह्यं रन्धयन् मा चाहं द्विषते रधं तवेद् विष्णो बहुधा वीर्याऽणि ।
त्वं नः पृणीहि पशुभिर्विश्वरूपैः सुधायां मा धेहि परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: udagādayamādityo viśvena tapasā saha sapatnān mahyaṃ randhayan mā cāhaṃ dviṣate radhaṃ taved viṣṇo bahudhā vīryā'ṇi tvaṃ naḥ pṛṇīhi paśubhirviśvarūpaiḥ sudhāyāṃ mā dhehi parame vyo'man
verses.en: With all his fiery fervour this Aditya hath gone up on high, Giving my foes into my hand. Let me not be my foeman's prey. Manifold are thy great deeds, thine, O Vishnu, Sate us with cattle of all varied colours, Set me in happiness, in loftiest heaven.

verses.sa:
आदित्य नावमारुक्षः शतारित्रां स्वस्तये ।
अहर्मात्यपीपरो रात्रिं सत्राति पारय॥
verses.tr: āditya nāvamārukṣaḥ śatāritrāṃ svastaye aharmātyapīparo rātriṃ satrāti pāraya
verses.en: Thou for our weal, Aditya, hast mounted thy ship: with hundred oars, Thou hast transported me to day: so bear me evermore to night,

verses.sa:
सूर्य नावमारुक्षः शतारित्रां स्वस्तये ।
रात्रिं मात्यपीपरोऽहः सत्राति पारय॥
verses.tr: sūrya nāvamārukṣaḥ śatāritrāṃ svastaye rātriṃ mātyapīparo'haḥ satrāti pāraya
verses.en: Thou for our weal, O Surya, hast mounted thy ship with hundred oars, Thou hast transported me to night: so bear me evermore to day.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतेरावृतो ब्रह्मणा वर्मणाहं कश्यपस्य ज्योतिषा वर्चसा च ।
जरदष्टिः कृतवीर्यो विहायाः सहस्रायुः सुकृतश्चरेयम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpaterāvṛto brahmaṇā varmaṇāhaṃ kaśyapasya jyotiṣā varcasā ca jaradaṣṭiḥ kṛtavīryo vihāyāḥ sahasrāyuḥ sukṛtaścareyam
verses.en: Encompassed by Prajapati's devotion as shield, with Kasyapa's bright light and splendour, Reaching old age, may I made strong and mighty live through a thousand years with happy fortune,

verses.sa:
परीवृतो ब्रह्मणा वर्मणाहं कश्यपस्य ज्योतिषा वर्चसा च ।
मा मा प्रापन्निषवो दैव्या या मा मानुषीरवसृष्टाः वधाय॥
verses.tr: parīvṛto brahmaṇā varmaṇāhaṃ kaśyapasya jyotiṣā varcasā ca mā mā prāpanniṣavo daivyā yā mā mānuṣīravasṛṣṭāḥ vadhāya
verses.en: Compassed am I with prayer, my shield and armour; compassed with Kasyapa's bright light and splendour. Let not shafts reach me shot from heaven against me, nor those sent forth by men for my destruction.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन गुप्त ऋतुभिश्च सर्वैर्भूतेन गुप्तो भव्येन चाहम्।
मा मा प्रापत् पाप्मा मोत मृत्युरन्तर्दधेऽहं सलिलेन वाचः॥
verses.tr: ṛtena gupta ṛtubhiśca sarvairbhūtena gupto bhavyena cāham mā mā prāpat pāpmā mota mṛtyurantardadhe'haṃ salilena vācaḥ
verses.en: Guarded am I by Order and the Seasons, protected by the past and by the future. Let not distress, yea, let not Death come nigh me: with water of my speech have I o'erwhelmed them,

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मा गोप्ता परि पातु विश्वतः उद्यन्त्सूर्यो नुदतां मृत्युपाशान्।
व्युच्छन्तीरुषसः पर्वता ध्रुवाः सहस्रं प्राणा मय्या यतन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: agnirmā goptā pari pātu viśvataḥ udyantsūryo nudatāṃ mṛtyupāśān vyucchantīruṣasaḥ parvatā dhruvāḥ sahasraṃ prāṇā mayyā yatantām
verses.en: On every side let Agni guard and keep me; the rising Sun drive off the snares of Mrityu! Let brightly flushing Mornings, firm-set mountains, and lives a thousand be with me united.
